source.title: Safety-Relevant Biomedical Machine Learning Should Adopt Stability-First Reporting
source.authors: Z. A. Zainal; O. Kavehei; I. Aguilar; L. F. Herbozo Contreras; Z. Huang

record.file_problem: The supplied text appears to contain the full preprint, including appendices and tables.
record.tranche_reason: The paper measures training loss and curvature relative to the stability threshold in an MLP experiment. This is a conceptual test of the Edge of Stability behavior in V5, but uses a different model, dataset, loss, and optimizer regime.
record.gate_note: The PathMNIST experiment reports training loss and sharpness relative to the 2/η threshold. CIFAR-10 and CHB-MIT results report test accuracy/AUC and time-to-target, not training classification error or an EoS measurement tied to those results, so they are not rows. Cited results from other studies are excluded.
record.test_reason: The PathMNIST probe measures decreasing loss and probe-batch curvature under mini-batch SGD. It does not establish recovery above the initial linearized stability limit, full-batch boundary tracking, or divergence below the initial threshold. These diagnostic results concern a related optimization phenomenon but do not test V5 as stated.
record.authors_conclusion: The record accurately summarizes the authors' interpretation of the PathMNIST probe. Their broader conclusion advocates stress-tested biomedical ML reporting, with training diagnostics accompanied by assumptions and validated links to deployment-relevant degradation. The probe itself does not validate that link.
record.recipe_differences: Uses mini-batch SGD with cross-entropy on a PathMNIST MLP; V5 describes wide-network squared-loss experiments and full-batch training results.
record.method_sensitivity: The reported EoS probe uses a fixed learning rate η = 0.01 and mini-batch SGD. The study does not compare alternative learning rates or optimizers in this probe.

fits_no_version.finding: Across 10 PathMNIST MLP runs using mini-batch SGD, mean loss fell from 1.824 to 0.784. Mean peak probe-batch sharpness was 382.5 and final sharpness was 227.5, compared with the nominal quadratic reference of 200.
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: Mini-batch SGD can reduce training loss overall while fixed-probe-batch curvature exceeds the nominal full-batch quadratic stability reference.

record.peer_reviewed: medRxiv preprint; not certified by peer review
record.problems: The EoS experiment uses one architecture and dataset, with 10 seeds. The curvature estimate is from a fixed probe batch rather than the full training objective; the authors note that the local quadratic reference is not a convergence guarantee. The reported aggregate metrics do not establish the transient loss-rise-and-recovery pattern or boundary hovering in V5.
record.rows_left_out: CIFAR-10 and CHB-MIT optimizer comparisons in Table 2 and Figures 4–5 report test metrics and time-to-target rather than training classification error or EoS behavior, so they do not meet the row criteria for these versions.

untested.parts: Near-zero training classification error on CIFAR-10/CIFAR-100, including random labels and dependencies on size, stopping, or regularization. The optimizer benchmarks report test performance.
Teacher-student spurious minima and the effect of adding student neurons.
Training degradation with depth, identity shortcuts, and the stated initialization exceptions.
Initialization comparisons, signal propagation, training speed, and trainable depth.

Recovery above the initial linearized stability limit in wide squared-loss networks; divergence at larger rates; full-batch progressive sharpening and sustained boundary tracking; divergence despite initially subthreshold rates.
Batch normalization comparisons for training speed and learning-rate tolerance, and Fixup comparisons.

record.verdict_notes: Remove both V5 verdicts. The diagnostic observation does not establish V5's specified dynamics, and unmeasured dynamics or different experimental settings do not themselves justify limits_scope. Appendix D.2 summarizes prior work rather than additional results from this study.

versions.untested_parts: Training classification error on CIFAR-10/CIFAR-100, including corrupted or random labels; model size, early stopping, and regularization.
Two-layer ReLU teacher-student spurious minima and student width relative to teacher width.
Depth, residual shortcuts, and training error in plain versus residual networks.
Activation-matched initialization, signal and gradient propagation, and trainable depth.

The experiment does not test a brief loss rise followed by curvature drop, full-batch sharpness hovering at the threshold over longer times, or divergence from runs initially below the threshold. It uses mini-batch SGD, cross-entropy, and a PathMNIST MLP rather than the version's wide squared-loss setting.
Batch normalization versus no normalization, training speed and learning-rate tolerance, and Fixup.

rows.subject: fully connected MLP (2352 → 256 → 128 → 9)
rows.operation_detail: Trained on PathMNIST with mini-batch SGD and cross-entropy for 50 epochs; learning rate η = 0.01.
rows.uncertainty: 95% confidence intervals are reported for initial and final loss; loss reduction uncertainty not stated.
rows.note: The reported aggregate is across 10 seeds. The text says curvature exceeds the threshold, but does not describe a brief loss rise followed by recovery.
rows.check: The reported loss values are correct, but endpoint loss reduction cannot establish V5's recovery dynamics or loss descent during full-batch boundary tracking. The initial full-objective stability limit is not measured.

rows.subject: fully connected MLP (2352 → 256 → 128 → 9)
rows.operation_detail: Measured the largest Hessian eigenvalue during SGD training and compared it with the nominal stability threshold 2/η.
rows.measure: Sharpness (largest Hessian eigenvalue) relative to stability limit
rows.uncertainty: 95% confidence intervals are reported for peak and final sharpness; the peak sharpness range is [306.9, 522.0].
rows.note: The paper states that the sharpness proxy exceeds the nominal stability threshold. The threshold is treated as a diagnostic reference, not a convergence guarantee.
rows.check: The numbers match Table 1, but sharpness is estimated on a fixed probe batch during mini-batch SGD. Peak and final estimates relative to 200 do not establish the full-objective stability threshold or sustained boundary tracking required by V5.

source_check.scope: Only the listed rows, labels and statements were checked; presence is not whole-study approval.
